family_reports.body: THE SYSTEM IS CORRUPT AND YOU HAVE TO PAY TO PLAY! GOOD PARENTS ARE LOSING THEIR CHILDREN OVER $$$$$!
it has completely turned our lives upside down.

My family and life were ripped apart to keep USD 232 from consequences, and the lies told by multiple bad actors only impact me since there is no accountability for them.The only evidence available is the same evidence that would exonerate me but it would require unbiased court actors to look at it that way.

I'm a survivor of domestic violence. My 2 abusive exes constantly made false allegations against me. CASA ignored the mountains of evidence that I had. I lost my kids due to false allegations and CASA. DCF knew all the reports were false and had no concerns with me.

public_comments.comment_text: Ignored all domestic violence. I hate Judge Triplett, Judge Sloan, and CASA. Abusive dad teamed up with my abusive parents who worked with CASA to take my kids. 2 children in foster care and 1 with his dad. I have only supervised visitation. CASA of Wyandotte and Johnson County has ruined my life.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Would not recognize the child’s disability or the hiring of a special Education law firm. Would not provide clarity of the case. Is associated with the city of USD232. Unconventional court appearances that were not recorded. Recused herself from the case and did not provide any explanation.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: She puts restrictions on me as a non party and didn't give me a chance to defend myself against the allegations that led to the restrictions and required no proof. She was moved off our cases and now we have new judges, waiting to see if anything changes
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Did not care about any evidence I presented, gave everything to my ex and her POS lawyer and is making me pay her attorneys fees just for defending myself
